parameters.name: EndDate
parameters.description:
The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the YYYY-MM-DD format.

The default value is the day when you perform the operation.

parameters.name: StartDate
parameters.description:
The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the YYYY-MM-DD format.

You can query only the DNS records of the latest 90 days. `The value of StartDate must be greater than or equal to the difference between the current date and 90`.

parameters.name: SubDomain
parameters.description: The subdomain whose statistics you want to query.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun alidns describe-doh-sub-domain-statistics --lang en --sub-domain www.example.com --start-date 2019-07-04 --end-date 2019-07-04 --region cn-hangzhou
